messages:
Sam: Quick q — infra asked if we can stream audit events for routing-policy and quota changes to customer SIEMs without blowing up our export quotas. Anyone tried this at scale?
Maria: We have a prototype. Main issues: export throughput, PII redaction cost, and tenant-level throttles. If we do realtime streaming per-tenant that can spike IO.
Jordan: Is the ask 'full events' or 'summaries'? Full events includes before/after diffs which are heavier.
Sam: They want who changed what + before/after + request id. Pretty chatty for high churn tenants.
Lee: Performance note: routing policy updates are small but frequent. The big cost is signature+encryption per-event if customers want signed proofs.
Ana: Could we batch per-tenant for 30s windows, sign the bundle once, and stream the bundle when ready? That reduces crypto ops.
Maria: yup batching helps. Also offer multiple export modes: realtime stream (best-effort), batch bundles (S3/HTTPS), and webhook multiplexer. Console toggle per-tenant.
Jordan: Redaction: two modes — redact-in-flight (strip PII server-side), or tokenization where we replace PII with stable tokens and include a separate mapping export (access-restricted).
Sam: Tokenization + separate mapping seems good for customers who need re-identification, but adds storage/rotation burden.
Lee: Proposal: default to 'mask' for hosted, 'tokenize' opt-in for Dedicated/Private. Rate-limit: 5k events/min per tenant for realtime streams, with burst to 20k for enterprise tiers.
Maria: UX: console should show live export throughput, current quota usage, and a 'pause export' button. Also an audit row showing last bundle signed timestamp.
Ana: We should also emit telemetry events for export throttles so SRE can detect backpressure on the routing engine — e.g., export_queue_size, export_dropped_count.
infra-bot: export-service: started stream handshake for tenant=t-47, protocol=ndjson, conn_id=conn-997 (info)
Jordan: Sample config we discussed:
```
export:
  mode: realtime
  format: ndjson
  redaction: tokenize
  token_service: kms
  rate_limit_per_minute: 5000
  batch_window_seconds: 30
  signed: true
```
Maria: Implementation notes: signing should be async after batch formation; don't block main routing update path. Use separate worker pool with backpressure to avoid tail latency.
Sam: For compliance export downloads we also need an 'export audit trail' showing who requested the export and what filters were applied — tie to the same audit logs.
Lee: Dev plan: (1) prototyping batching + sign worker, (2) tenant quota enforcement + metrics, (3) console UI toggles and usage panel, (4) rollout behind feature flag with canary tenants.
Ana: Rollout timeline suggestion: 2-week proto, 1-week load test, 2-week canary (10 tenants), then GA.
Maria: I'll open a spec doc and link it. For now can we align on default quotas and redaction modes?
Sam: Agree on defaults: mask by default, tokenize opt-in, realtime quota 5k/min default, enterprise tiers configurable. I'll capture and create ticket.
Lee: +1
Jordan: +1
infra-bot: export-service: handshake failed for tenant=t-99 (rate_limit_exceeded) — dropped connection (warn)
Sam: OK thanks — I'll owner the ticket and ping legal about tokenization policy.
